en.title: Get started
en.description: From download to your first session in a few minutes. Current release: **v{version}**.

fields.name: 2. Requirements
fields.value:
Minecraft {minecraft}
Fabric Loader {loader} or newer
Java {java} or newer
Fabric API (required), Mod Menu (optional)

fields.name: 3. Installation
fields.value: Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft {minecraft}. Put the ThePrisons jar and Fabric API into your `mods` folder.

fields.name: 4. Launch
fields.value: Start Minecraft with the Fabric profile and join Cosmic Prisons.

fields.name: 5. Open the dashboard
fields.value: Type `/prisons`. Pick a design and arrange the HUD with the HUD editor.

fields.name: 6. Support
fields.value: Check {channel_faq} first. Still stuck? [Open an issue]({issues_url}) with your version and `logs/latest.log`.
